items.title: Practicing Digital Etiquette and Responsible Communication (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Practicing Digital Etiquette and Responsible Communication (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Digital etiquette (online adaab) ka matlab hai online mahol mein shaistagi, izzat aur wazahat se baat karna. Is mein munasib zaban use karna, doosron ki raye ka ehtram karna aur communication tools ka ghalat istemal na karna shamil hai. Talaba online baat-cheet mein private maloomat share na karein aur be-adabi na karein. Zimmedarana communication teamwork ko barhata hai aur mosbat (positive) aur professional digital mahol banaye rakhta hai. Misal: class ke group chat mein talaba discussion ke dauran doosron ki raye ka ehtram karein. Sanjeeda taleemi guftagu ke dauran spam messages, be-talluq memes ya jokes bhejne se bachein. Is se group fayda-mand, izzat wala aur parhai par focused rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Class ke group chat mein achhi digital etiquette ki do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Doosron ki raye ka ehtram karna, aur sanjeeda parhai ki guftagu mein spam, ghair-mutalliq memes ya mazaq na bhejna. (Zaati maloomat share na karna aur ba-adab zaban bhi.)

blocks.prompt: Poore section 9.1 ka jaiza: Aap ka cousin email, Facebook aur shopping app ke liye aik hi chhota password, apna naam aur paidaish ka saal, use karta hai. Use teen mashware dein.
blocks.explanation: Lamba password (12 ya zyada characters) jis mein huroof, numbers aur symbols hon aur kuch zaati na ho; har account ka alag password, shayad password manager ke saath; aur two-factor authentication on karein, taake sirf chori ka password account na khol sake.

items: Digital etiquette: online ba-adab, izzat aur wazahat se baat.
Munasib zaban, doosron ki raye ka ehtram, communication tools ka ghalat istemal nahi.
